name: Conservation-Constrained Gaussian Splitting
aliases: Gaussian Splitting via Integral Tensor Equations
definition: A method to split an inhomogeneous 3D Gaussian into two new Gaussians using a 3D plane while maintaining 3D visual consistency, avoiding needle-like artifacts and unstable loss decline associated with direct copy-based splitting.
summary: Conservation-Constrained Gaussian Splitting is a closed-form method that splits 3D Gaussians via integral tensor equations to preserve visual consistency and eliminate artifacts.
